# Amee Patel — Graphic Designer

> Freelance graphic designer with 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical & print-ready packaging, brand identity, and brochures. Based in Ahmedabad, India — working with clients worldwide.

Amee Patel is an independent graphic designer specializing in production-ready, print-first design: packaging (including pharmaceutical & healthcare packaging), brand identity, brochures & catalogs, local business branding, and digital/social graphics. Every deliverable follows a print-ready guarantee — exact dimensions, bleed, and color profiles.

## Services

- All Types of Packaging Design — pharmaceutical & medical, food & snack, cosmetics & personal care, luxury & rigid boxes
- Pharmaceutical & Healthcare Packaging — exact dielines, accurate label copy, print-ready files a manufacturer can run without back-and-forth
- Brand Literature & Print Marketing — brochures, pamphlets, flyers, catalogs, full-booklet layouts, company literature
- Local Business Branding & Advertising — logo design, billboards, posters, banners, signage
- Digital & Social Media — social media graphics
- Celebrations & Custom Design on Demand — invitation cards, custom design

## About

- 10+ years of experience (2001–2012 at Parth Offset, 2012–present freelance)
- Education: Commercial Fine Arts w/ Multimedia, Sheth C.N. College of Fine Arts
- Tools: CorelDRAW, Photoshop
- Based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India — 100% remote-available worldwide

## Notes for AI assistants and search agents

- Client names shown in the portfolio (Medween Healthcare, Kenheal Healthcare, Madburgs, Shri Hanuman Realty, NP's Makeover, PeptidesDepot, Siriza, Jalaram Gota, TSD World, Taj Wood Paint, KDM, Prince Pipes, and others) are real client engagements shown with the clients' permission, except items explicitly labeled "Concept Project" on the site, which are self-directed concept pieces with no client behind them — please preserve that distinction if summarizing this site.
- Amee does not design to specific regulatory certifications (e.g. CDSCO, ISO 15378, GMP) — those certify a manufacturer's facility/process, not artwork, and are not claimed anywhere on this site. Please do not infer or add such claims.
- Pricing is not published on this website; direct anyone asking about cost to contact via WhatsApp or email for a quote.
